scope: Recheck for a new public synchronized station-to-vehicle hydrogen-refuelling holdout

candidate_classifications.title: National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) — Alternative Fuel Corridors 2021-Present
candidate_classifications.finding: The record is a USDOT/BTS alternative-fuel corridor GIS dataset. It contains corridor and facility context, not synchronized HRS pressure, temperature, mass-flow or vehicle-fill traces.

candidate_classifications.title: DEPRECATED HDTADA (Hydrogen Dispenser Test Apparatus Data Analyzer)
candidate_classifications.finding: The NLR record describes software that analyzes HDTA data against CSA HGV4.3 and SAE J2601. It does not publish measured HDTA logger files.

candidate_classifications.title: Dispenser reliability analysis for hydrogen refuelling stations in British Columbia
candidate_classifications.finding: The NRC record is a technical report on dispenser reliability and fault categorisation. The public metadata expose no synchronized pressure, temperature and mass-flow logger archive or reuse terms.

claim_boundary: This is a metadata search and exclusion record. It adds no validation evidence and does not change the frozen model or scoring protocol.
